projects.title: ReconViaGen Studio
projects.description: Multi-view images to 3D models. A local studio connected to a protected H100 inference API.
projects.details: Pinned application source and CUDA dependencies live in an immutable Modal Image. Model checkpoints live in a persistent Volume, surviving redeploys and scale-to-zero. The studio forwards 1–8 ordered views and returns a GLB for preview and download.
projects.operations: One-container maximum, no function retries, and a two-second idle scale-down window. GPU failures stop the batch runner for manual investigation.

projects.title: Cosmos Motion Studio
projects.description: Asynchronous image-to-video generation with a Flask interface and cloud GPU workers.
projects.details: The local Flask application submits images and motion prompts to Modal, polls job progress, and returns finished video for preview and download. Model weights are stored in a persistent Modal Volume.
projects.operations: Scale-to-zero GPU workers and one generation at a time. The interface supports cancellation and records submission, processing, download, and errors.

projects.title: MiniMax H3 Serving
projects.description: Video generation served through SGLang, with persistent artifacts and a local log watchdog.
projects.details: Deploys MiniMax H3 Base through SGLang on Modal. Hugging Face weights persist in a Modal Volume; generated MP4 files and JSON reports are stored together for each generation.
projects.operations: A local watchdog streams timestamped Modal logs and mirrors the log into persistent storage. Deployment configuration selects the model variant and GPU count.

projects.title: Email Provisioning
projects.description: Python automation for creating email accounts through the Purelymail REST API.
projects.details: A focused integration project for creating email through Purelymail’s REST interface.
projects.operations: Repository documentation is minimal. Explore the source for the implementation; production monitoring and deployment are not documented.

projects.title: SMTP Email Automation
projects.description: A Python project for sending email over SMTP.
projects.details: Despite the repository name, its README describes sending email using SMTP.
projects.operations: A small automation project. The public README does not document production deployment or reliability guarantees.
